definitions.explanation: excessively desirous of acquiring wealth or possessions
having a strong appetite or enthusiasm for learning, growth, or achievement

examples.japanese: {貪欲|どんよく}な⟦{金持|かねも}ち→金持ち：02993_kanemochi⟧。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{貪欲|どんよく}だ。
⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{貪欲|どんよく}な⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。

notes:
SENSE 1 - NEGATIVE (greed):
- {貪欲|どんよく}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (greedy person)
- {貪欲|どんよく}さ (greediness)
One of the Seven Deadly Sins in Christianity.

SENSE 2 - POSITIVE (eagerness):
- ⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{貪欲|どんよく} (hungry for knowledge)
- ⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{貪欲|どんよく} (eager for growth)
- ⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{貪欲|どんよく} (hungry for victory)
In this usage, implies admirable drive and ambition.

ALTERNATE READING:
Also read as どんよく (more common) or たん⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧ (literary).

FORMS:
- Adverb: {貪欲|どんよく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧
- Noun form: {貪欲|どんよく}さ
